title: Smash Hockey — how it is played
description: The five questions SMASH-50 asked, and nothing else. Panels are generated: edit telemetry/grafana/build-dashboards.py, not this JSON, and not the UI.

list.name: env
list.label: Build
list.description: Defaults to production: a developer's flights must never quietly join the numbers. Until a store build exists, production is empty and today's rows are under staging.

list.name: platform
list.label: Platform
list.description: Defaults to both: one game, one dataset. Splitting it is a question about the port, worth asking on purpose.

panels.title: Installs

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT install_id) AS installs
    FROM matches
    WHERE true
      AND ('$env' = 'both' OR env = '$env')
      AND ('$platform' = 'both' OR platform = '$platform')
      AND NOT synthetic

panels.description: Distinct install ids that have played a match.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS matches
    FROM matches
    WHERE true
      AND ('$env' = 'both' OR env = '$env')
      AND ('$platform' = 'both' OR platform = '$platform')
      AND NOT synthetic

panels.title: Last row

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_timestamp(max(at) / 1000) AS "last row"
    FROM matches
    WHERE true
      AND ('$env' = 'both' OR env = '$env')
      AND ('$platform' = 'both' OR platform = '$platform')
      AND NOT synthetic

panels.description: By the device's own clock. If this is old, nothing is sending — check the app's launch log.

panels.title: 1 · How many matches before someone stops

targets.rawSql:
WITH per_install AS (
  SELECT install_id, count(*) AS played
    FROM matches
    WHERE true
      AND ('$env' = 'both' OR env = '$env')
      AND ('$platform' = 'both' OR platform = '$platform')
      AND NOT synthetic

  GROUP BY install_id
), total AS (
  SELECT count(*)::float AS installs FROM per_install
)
SELECT n AS "match",
       CASE WHEN (SELECT installs FROM total) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE 100.0 * (SELECT count(*) FROM per_install WHERE played >= n) / (SELECT installs FROM total)
       END AS "installs still playing"
  FROM generate_series(1, 40) AS n
 ORDER BY n

panels.description: The fraction of installs that reached at least N matches. Read where it falls; the 20-match mark is §17.2's hard-fought threshold.

panels.title: 3 · Do they come back

targets.rawSql:
WITH span AS (
  SELECT install_id,
         min(at) AS first_ms,
         (max(at) - min(at)) / 86400000.0 AS days
    FROM matches
    WHERE true
      AND ('$env' = 'both' OR env = '$env')
      AND ('$platform' = 'both' OR platform = '$platform')
      AND NOT synthetic

  GROUP BY install_id
)
SELECT d AS "day",
       CASE WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000 - first_ms) / 86400000.0 >= d) = 0
            THEN NULL
            ELSE 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE days >= d)
                 / count(*) FILTER (WHERE (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000 - first_ms) / 86400000.0 >= d)
       END AS "installs still coming back"
  FROM generate_series(1, 14) AS d, span
 GROUP BY d
 ORDER BY d

panels.description: The fraction still returning N days after their first match. Installs younger than the day being counted are excluded, so a phone set up this morning is not churn.

panels.title: 2 · Finished a season

targets.rawSql:
WITH started AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT install_id
    FROM matches
    WHERE true
      AND ('$env' = 'both' OR env = '$env')
      AND ('$platform' = 'both' OR platform = '$platform')
      AND NOT synthetic
      AND competition IN ('league', 'cup')
), finished AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT install_id
    FROM seasons
    WHERE true
      AND ('$env' = 'both' OR env = '$env')
      AND ('$platform' = 'both' OR platform = '$platform')
      AND NOT synthetic

)
SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM started) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE 100.0 * (SELECT count(*) FROM finished) / (SELECT count(*) FROM started) END
       AS "finished a season"

panels.description: Of installs that played a league or cup match. Someone who has only played a friendly has not started a season, so they are not in the denominator.

panels.title: 3 · Came back on day 7

targets.rawSql:
WITH span AS (
  SELECT install_id, min(at) AS first_ms, (max(at) - min(at)) / 86400000.0 AS days
    FROM matches
    WHERE true
      AND ('$env' = 'both' OR env = '$env')
      AND ('$platform' = 'both' OR platform = '$platform')
      AND NOT synthetic

  GROUP BY install_id
), eligible AS (
  SELECT * FROM span WHERE (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000 - first_ms) / 86400000.0 >= 7
)
SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE days >= 7) / count(*) END AS "day 7"
  FROM eligible

panels.description: Of installs at least 7 days old. This is the number A3 lives or dies by.

panels.title: 4 · Ever won the cup

targets.rawSql:
WITH ended AS (
  SELECT install_id, bool_or(cup_won) AS won
    FROM seasons
    WHERE true
      AND ('$env' = 'both' OR env = '$env')
      AND ('$platform' = 'both' OR platform = '$platform')
      AND NOT synthetic

  GROUP BY install_id
)
SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE won) / count(*) END AS "won the cup"
  FROM ended

panels.description: Of installs that finished a season. If this is near zero the cup is not a reward, it is a rumour.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS seasons
    FROM seasons
    WHERE true
      AND ('$env' = 'both' OR env = '$env')
      AND ('$platform' = 'both' OR platform = '$platform')
      AND NOT synthetic

panels.title: Both platforms, same measures

targets.rawSql:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT platform, install_id, count(*) AS played,
         avg(goals_for)::numeric(10,2) AS gf, avg(goals_against)::numeric(10,2) AS ga,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE result = 'won') AS won
    FROM matches
   WHERE ('$env' = 'both' OR env = '$env') AND NOT synthetic
   GROUP BY platform, install_id
)
SELECT platform,
       count(*)                               AS installs,
       sum(played)                            AS matches,
       round(avg(played), 1)                  AS "matches per install",
       round(100.0 * sum(won) / NULLIF(sum(played), 0), 1) AS "won %",
       round(avg(gf), 2)                      AS "goals for",
       round(avg(ga), 2)                      AS "goals against"
  FROM m
 GROUP BY platform
 ORDER BY platform

panels.description: A table and not a chart: these are a percentage, a count and a goal average, and one chart carrying three units would need two y-axes. A difference here that is not a written platform-delta row is a bug. Ignores the platform picker — this panel is the comparison.

panels.title: Most recent matches

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_timestamp(at / 1000) AS "played at", platform, env, commit, world, competition,
       goals_for AS gf, goals_against AS ga, result, trailed, hard_fought, matches_played AS "lifetime"
    FROM matches
    WHERE true
      AND ('$env' = 'both' OR env = '$env')
      AND ('$platform' = 'both' OR platform = '$platform')
      AND NOT synthetic

 ORDER BY at DESC
 LIMIT 50

panels.description: For confirming a build actually reports, and what it reports. `commit` is the code that wrote the row (§18.1).
